content.content:
1	# Moneo: Deep Weed Audit — Tests, PR History, Documentation, Tooling
2	
3	**Audit date:** 2026-11-09  
4	**Repository:** https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo  
5	**Audited branch/HEAD:** `main` at `ce7995b817ec45c719527d7d3dcfcbe7400f214e`  
6	**Status:** Findings and implementation specification; **no changes made** to the repository.  
7	**Audience:** Codex / Claude Code / maintainers.  
8	**Objective:** Reduce maintenance friction and false confidence while increasing protection against genuinely expensive financial, privacy, data-loss, and authorization failures.
9	
10	> **Read this first:** This is a repository/PR **static audit**, not a claim that the suite was executed on the user's computer. I read GitHub PR metadata for **131 PRs (128 merged; 3 closed unmerged)**, examined important PR bodies and file changes, inventoried the current tree, and inspected representative high-risk tests, runner configuration, instructions and production code. I did **not** execute Docker, Vitest, Playwright, live provider tests, or measure performance. Recommendations labeled *suspected* require a local red/green reproduction before editing behavior. Do not delete tests merely because they are old, large, or mocked.
11	
12	---
13	
14	## 0. Executive decision
15	
16	**Do not delete the entire test suite.** The principal weeds are **selection/orchestration, QA isolation, shared mutable state, implementation-coupled tests, misleading test names, and missing failure-oriented tests**. The best approach is to replace a small number of weak checks, remove their old forms *after* replacement coverage passes, and organize the remaining tests by purpose.
17	
18	**Five first moves, in order:**
19	
20	1. **Make test execution safe:** require explicit dedicated QA identity, isolate any browser tests with mutations, refuse to run a browser suite against the owner's workspace or an unverified existing server.
21	2. **Repair acceptance selection:** optional real-AI/MCP tests must not cause a mandatory zero-skip suite to fail; remove dynamic test skips caused by mutable initial UI state.
22	3. **Replace implementation-text testing:** retire source-string assertions in `scripts/acceptance.test.ts` once behavioral runner tests exist.
23	4. **Tie regression coverage to actual severe PR incidents:** deployed `PT409` conflict behavior, cross-screen net-worth parity, artifact exfiltration boundaries, OAuth host-ID contract, import undo/re-import idempotency, and self-host recovery.
24	5. **Split fast vs DB vs browser vs release vs provider vs performance:** preserve strong SQL/finance/RLS/security tests; avoid one oversized gate for all changes.
25	
26	**Avoid:** building a second giant testing framework; deleting all unit tests; deleting SQL regression fixtures; reintroducing real AI calls in default CI; changing production data to satisfy test fixtures; editing previously applied migrations; running `docker compose down -v`.
27	
28	---
29	
30	## 1. Inventory of what exists now
31	
32	| Type | Current repository inventory | What it means |
33	|---|---:|---|
34	| Vitest `*.test.ts(x)` files | **295** | Mixed unit, components, API-route, contract, some live-database tests |
35	| Playwright `*.spec.ts` files | **60** | **52** `.gated`, **7** `.mocked`, **1** `.smoke` |
36	| `supabase/tests/*.sql` | **53** test SQL files + **2** fixture SQL files | Migration/RLS/SQL regression tests; not all individual test cases counted |
37	| `.live.test.ts` | **8** of the 295 Vitest files | Opt-in tests guarded by environment flags |
38	| Performance tools | **3** (`bench-cards.mts`, `perf-pages.mjs`, `perf-interactions.mjs`) | Measurement scripts, **not** enforced budgets |
39	| Additional integration tools | Workflow runtime tests, migration replay, SQL concurrency runners | Valuable but some run only through nondefault commands |
40	| GitHub Actions under `.github/workflows` | **0 files** in audited tree | No checked-in Actions CI policy |
41	| Static QA/agent setup | `AGENTS.md`, `e2e/README.md`, `supabase/tests/README.md`, `.claude/settings.json`, `.entire/settings.json` | Some policies describe more assurance than the runner actually provides |
42	
43	**Existing commands:** `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build`, `npm run test:e2e`, `npm run acceptance:fast`, `npm run acceptance:required`, `npm run check:privacy`. `pretest` and `prelint` invoke the privacy filename check. `playwright.config.ts` runs Chromium Desktop Chrome and can reuse an existing dev server on port 3000. No dedicated `typecheck` npm script or CI pipeline is defined in `package.json`.
44	
45	**Preserve as high-value coverage:** financial amount/currency/rounding tests, immutable source and undo tests, `lib/finance/net-worth-source.test.ts`, balance and reservation live tests, SQL replay + RLS (`workspace-isolation.sql`), concurrency tests, authorization-scope revocation in `app/api/chat/route.test.ts`, and hostile artifact-browser tests. These guard costly bugs and are not merely decoration.
46	
47	---
48	
49	## 2. PR archaeology: real evidence of weeds
50	
51	| PR and evidence | Pattern exposed | What test should now exist |
52	|---|---|---|
53	| [#91 — Fix stale browser tests and QA login](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/91): reported **30 browser failures and 27 skipped**, already stale before code cleanup | Browser assertions and auth fixtures drift with UI; “more E2E” can turn into test maintenance | Stable role-based journey tests and deterministic identity/setup; disallow arbitrary skip-as-success |
54	| [#140 — User-testing audit repairs](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/140): **no single fully green `acceptance:required` run**; one reported full suite was **82/83**, different tests failed in slow patches | The all-or-nothing release gate is noisy and hard to interpret; state/timing coupling | Fresh QA workspace per suite; independent deterministic E2E; duration/flake telemetry; real readiness signals |
55	| [#146 — Self-hosted migration](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/146): 157 files affected; removed login/auth routes and tests; reported **18 test cleanup failures** and remaining browser failures | Huge platform migration invalidated old suite assumptions; install/update/recovery is not covered by the normal browser suite | Disposable first-install + upgrade + restart + restore smoke with preserved secrets/financial history |
56	| [#131 — SQLSTATE `40001` retry storm](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/131): stale conflict allegedly retried ~**1,100 times/s for 18 hours**, exhausting connections | Code can pass source checks while real HTTP/database semantics are catastrophically wrong | Real PostgREST conflict returns exactly one HTTP 409 promptly, without retry storm or connection starvation |
57	| [#132 — Cross-surface money totals](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/132): Overview, Accounts and Wealth gave contradictory totals | Per-component tests can all pass while the product violates a shared financial invariant | One seed drives Overview/Accounts/Wealth/chat/tool values; all match the same deterministic balance basis |
58	| [#160 — Artifact Page protection](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/160); [#142 closed unmerged](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/142): generated Pages could navigate/exfiltrate financial data | Passing generated HTML/syntax checks is not a security or correctness guarantee | Real frame-route headers + hostile HTML in Chromium; forbidden network/navigation; no secrets or financial data outbound |
59	| [#174 — ChatGPT sign-in rejection](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/174): bare UUID instead of `urn:uuid:` host identifier | Mocked OAuth calls overlooked external-provider contract | Deterministic host ID contract, migrated-ID test, and isolated opt-in real-provider smoke (never in default CI) |
60	| [#124 — Voice performance regression](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/124): +94 KB JS, hidden tab polling, 68 RSC requests/12s, CLS regression | Green functional tests do not detect performance/cost regressions | Browser request-count/polling and CLS budgets with synthetic QA data and repeatable baseline |
61	| [#57 — E2E fixture mismatch](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/57): mocked conversation history inconsistent with reply; import assertions raced inspection | Mocks can fabricate impossible states and make tests fail for the wrong reason | Shared API schema/factory contracts; await operation completion, no arbitrary timers |
62	| [#26 — Fast versus required acceptance](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/26) and [#43 — live DB gate](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/43) | Good intent (skip detection/provenance) implemented with overly broad selection and source-string coupling | Explicit suite manifests + report/exit-code behavior tests, not grepping runner source |
63	| [#138 — Artifacts re-architecture](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/138): old builder routes and tests removed; new chat + QuickJS cards | Old implementation-era tests and docs must be audited after each major architectural pivot | Regression tests for today’s artifact workflow, not old builder implementation |
64	| [#19 — Removed private bank inputs](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/19) | Filename gate alone does not prevent embedded secrets in code/docs | Credential and sensitive-content scanning on staged/tracked files |
65	
66	**Interpretation:** Frequent PRs that repair test fixtures are not automatically bad, but #91, #140, and #146 together support a systemic issue with E2E maintenance. #131, #132, #160 and #174 show genuine missing cross-boundary assertions. Prioritize those missing assertions over cosmetic test-count targets.
67	
68	---
69	
70	## 3. Findings — confirmed code facts, risk and fix
71	
72	### P0-01 — Mandatory acceptance includes intentionally optional tests
73	
74	**Evidence:** `scripts/acceptance.mjs` collects every root `e2e/*.spec.ts` except `core-journey.gated.spec.ts`, then `assertRequiredResults('playwright')` rejects **any** skipped test. Yet `e2e/net-worth-chat.gated.spec.ts` skips without `E2E_REAL_AI`; `e2e/scalable-trading.gated.spec.ts` skips without a local `SCALABLE_MCP_ORIGIN`; `e2e/home-dashboard.gated.spec.ts` skips at runtime if Goals is already first. The runner clears `OPENAI_API_KEY` and does not set the two opt-in variables.
75	
76	**Impact:** a working application can fail required acceptance for a test it never intended to execute. Also risks live-provider calls when accidental credentials leak into the environment.
77	
78	**Change:** Explicit allowlists for `qa:smoke`, `qa:db`, `qa:browser-required`, `qa:provider`, `qa:performance`; reject **unexpected** skips only within the relevant required list. Never select opt-in tests for regular browser acceptance. Test that the manifest includes *every* intended required test and excludes every opt-in test. Do not silently exclude new specs: new specs must be classified intentionally.
79	
80	**Proof:** run `playwright --list` for each manifest; required suite in correct test environment executes with zero skips; optional tests appear only on explicit invocation; no real-provider request during default tests.
81	
82	### P0-02 — Browser QA identity is not fail-closed
83	
84	**Evidence:** `e2e/agent-team.mocked.spec.ts`, `e2e/import-journey.mocked.spec.ts`, `e2e/import-control.mocked.spec.ts` use the QA cookie **if** present and otherwise proceed. Self-hosted `proxy.ts` automatically signs in the owner. `e2e/service-keys.mocked.spec.ts` *does* explicitly skip without QA session, showing contradictory policy. `e2e/README.md` says mocked specs need no session and tests never touch the owner workspace.
85	
86	**Impact:** **risk**, not proven incident: browser tests lacking QA cookies may execute as the automatically signed-in owner. Mocking an API route does not necessarily isolate every server-side read and action.
87	
88	**Change:** Central `e2e/qa-fixture.ts` with **mandatory** verified QA cookie/owner ID, dedicated synthetic workspace and guarded base URL. No test should run without explicit QA marker. For credential-free tests, serve an **isolated synthetic test server**, never the personal Moneo app. Block writes and fail if the workspace is not marked QA. Add negative tests confirming absent/wrong session refuses before opening browser.
89	
90	**Proof:** tests cannot start with no QA cookie, expired cookie, different owner or wrong base URL; only synthetic workspace rows change; cleanup checks after each suite.
91	
92	### P0-03 — E2E test runner may reuse an unintended development server
93	
94	**Evidence:** `playwright.config.ts`: `reuseExistingServer: !production && !process.env.CI` on port 3000; `E2E_BASE_URL` can point elsewhere. Combined with owner auto-sign-in, this is a potentially unsafe default.
95	
96	**Change:** Dedicated QA port and explicit readiness/identity response (not just port-open). Disallow shared-dev-server reuse for DB-mutating E2E unless verified as QA. Require `MONEO_TEST_INSTANCE=1` / QA owner marker checked server-side. Make production-build tests start their own known server.
97	
98	**Proof:** a non-QA server running on the port makes tests abort **before requests**.
99	
100	### P0-04 — QA reset bypasses database triggers/foreign keys
101	
102	**Evidence:** `scripts/e2e-auth.mjs --reset` checks `qa_test='e2e-auth'`, then uses `SET LOCAL session_replication_role = replica` and dynamically deletes by `workspace_id`, `actor_id`, `user_id`, `created_by` across all public tables.
103	
104	**Impact:** Deliberately disabling triggers/FKs can hide real integrity violations, and generic per-column sweeping is difficult to reason about after schema changes. Not evidence that the owner has been harmed; the QA-user guard is good.
105	
106	**Change:** Prefer disposable DB/isolated Docker or authenticated `reset_workspace()` with exact workspace/owner verification, full cleanup receipts and FK checks enabled. Keep explicit rejection for non-QA users. Fail on unexpected tables, never silently broaden deletion.
107	
108	**Proof:** seed one QA user and an unrelated user; reset QA; other user data bit-for-bit unchanged; FK/invariant checks remain active; repeatable cleanup even after failed test.
109	
110	### P1-05 — Acceptance tests assert runner source text
111	
112	**Evidence:** `scripts/acceptance.test.ts` scans test source and asserts that `scripts/acceptance.mjs` contains exact strings like `RUN_*_DB_TESTS: "1"` and `run("units", ... "--no-file-parallelism")`.
113	
114	**Impact:** A safe formatting/refactor can fail; a script containing the expected text in an unused branch could pass. Source checks are not proof of execution.
115	
116	**Change:** Export a pure suite manifest from the runner and test it as data; run a fake runner with success/fail/skip/flaky fixtures in isolated temp dirs, assert exit code, selected files, reports, absence of unexpected skips and provenance behavior. Keep the direct `assertProductionBuild` / `assertRequiredResults` unit cases (valuable).
117	
118	**Proof:** harmless refactor doesn't fail; removing DB flag from effective runtime config *does* fail.
119	
120	### P1-06 — Shared mutable E2E session and state
121	
122	**Evidence:** `e2e/auth-refresh.gated.spec.ts` writes refreshed cookies into the shared `e2e/.auth.json`; browser suites use a persistent QA workspace and require manual `scripts/e2e-auth.mjs --reset`; `e2e/home-dashboard.gated.spec.ts` dynamically skips if Goals already first. PR #140 recorded run-to-run variable failures.
123	
124	**Change:** Every stateful test should construct its starting data, use unique entities/workspace (or snapshot/reset per group), and not rewrite shared storage state. Convert Goals-first skip to deterministic arrangement or test both move/no-move paths. Collect per-test duration and retry/flake metadata.
125	
126	**Proof:** randomize suite order; run twice; run parallelizable mocked tests in parallel; no ordering dependency or skip.
127	
128	### P1-07 — Monolithic and mixed-fidelity browser journey
129	
130	**Evidence:** `e2e/core-journey.gated.spec.ts` mixes real database import, a real AI chat request, mocked inspect mapping and mocked deep-analysis completion, with 240-second test timeout. It is entirely excluded from required acceptance, although its non-AI part provides valuable product coverage. `e2e/scalable-trading.gated.spec.ts` combines a local MCP stand-in with a real model call.
131	
132	**Change:** Extract **deterministic app workflows** (import → ledger → re-import, card approval → recorded mutation, chat-tool invocation with stub model), and keep separate **opt-in provider evaluations**. Mark every mock boundary explicitly in test names/report. Never claim a model integration was verified because an API response was mocked.
133	
134	**Proof:** deterministic journeys pass offline on synthetic QA data; provider checks are separately reported with identity, model and cost labels.
135	
136	### P1-08 — Behavioral regression absent for catastrophic SQL retry semantics
137	
138	**Evidence:** `supabase/tests/conflict-errcode.test.ts` is a small regex scanning only migration files lexically later than `202610310001` for one exact `errcode = '40001'` pattern. #131 was a runtime PostgREST retry failure.
139	
140	**Change:** **Keep** this cheap guard, but add a deployed-PostgREST contract test causing a stale version conflict: assert one timely 409, returned error shape, bounded query count, no sustained retries, and a concurrent independent request still succeeds. Also test equivalent variations of SQLSTATE-raising syntax and all public conflict functions.
141	
142	**Proof:** the old dangerous behavior fails the new test; correct `PT409` passes. No real owner data.
143	
144	### P1-09 — Mocked security checks aren't a complete HTTP-boundary guarantee
145	
146	**Evidence:** `e2e/artifact-page-protection.mocked.spec.ts` is a useful browser test with hostile HTML, attempted `fetch`, beacon, image, popup, iframe/form and navigation. `lib/ai/artifact-data.test.ts` tests CSP strings. However the mocked harness doesn't guarantee the deployed `/ai/artifacts/[id]/frame` route sends exactly the intended CSP/cache headers, auth checks and data-scope checks.
147	
148	**Change:** Keep both tests. Add a separate **real route HTTP response** test with QA session: inspect actual `Content-Security-Policy`, `Cache-Control: private, no-store`, sandbox/no-same-origin, unauthorized/foreign artifact denial, and re-run hostile payload in actual `ArtifactFrame` with network requests captured.
149	
150	**Proof:** malicious page cannot send data, navigate to a foreign origin, load remote scripts or access parent cookies; legitimate local charts still render.
151	
152	### P1-10 — Financial semantic correctness lacks a single cross-system fixture
153	
154	**Evidence:** #132 repaired mismatched totals; `lib/finance/net-worth-source.test.ts` now tests cross-reader parity with a mocked query interface. Very good, but a real DB/RLS/route/browser multi-surface test is a different boundary. Cards also validate rendering/syntax rather than arbitrary AI-written finance arithmetic.
155	
156	**Change:** Reuse **one deterministic financial oracle**/fixture for accounts, balances, transfers, pending holds, FX, investments, debt and stale values. Verify API + Home + Accounts + Wealth + chat tool + artifact data outputs. Use property/metamorphic tests: adding balanced internal transfers doesn't change total net worth; same-currency rounding exact; re-import same source doesn't duplicate. For AI-generated cards, define which finance sums **must** come from precomputed trusted data, not model-authored arithmetic.
157	
158	**Proof:** intentional double-counting/missing-account mutants are killed. Avoid asserting implementation internals or formatting that is not contractual.
159	
160	### P1-11 — Security/privacy gate's name overstates coverage
161	
162	**Evidence:** `scripts/check-private-data.mjs` reads `git ls-files -z`, rejects extensions and ignored private directories, but **does not read file contents**. `AGENTS.md` says no secrets/private statements in repo; `pretest`/`prelint` running this script can convey false assurance. #19 removed tracked private bank files.
163	
164	**Change:** Keep filename guard (valuable). Add secret scanning/content signatures for credential patterns and accidental embedded financial identifiers; support explicit documented allowlist for synthetic fixtures. Run on staged content and all commits/PR diff where feasible, with redacted output. Don't upload private data to a third-party scanner without explicit approval.
165	
166	**Proof:** synthetic fake token/IBAN embedded in `.ts` or `.md` is flagged, harmless fixture passes, scanner never prints the secret.
167	
168	### P1-12 — First-install / update / recovery regression untested
169	
170	**Evidence:** #146 moved deployment to local Docker, data volumes and `.env` secrets; `scripts/setup.mjs` applies migrations and keeps existing secrets; test inventory has migration replay and UI tests but no complete disposable install → update → restore test.
171	
172	**Change:** In a disposable Docker project and throwaway temp directory, assert fresh install, restart, idempotent setup, migration upgrade, backup/restore and preservation of encrypted tokens/financial rows (using test-only keys). Never run destructive setup/restore against personal volumes. Add backup implementation as a separate project task if not present.
173	
174	**Proof:** restore exact synthetic ledger + secrets, reinstall doesn't overwrite keys, wrong key fails clearly, volume reset is never used on owner data.
175	
176	### P2-13 — Fixed sleeps and overly broad timeout budgets
177	
178	**Evidence:** `e2e/artifact-page-protection.mocked.spec.ts` waits 1,500 ms (for a known delayed attack); `e2e/import-journey.mocked.spec.ts` simulates a 20-second response delay; multiple gated specs allow 180–600 seconds. Timing itself isn't a failure but often makes feedback slow and nonrepeatable.
179	
180	**Change:** Use deferred promises, clock control or `expect.poll` at the *specific* observable event. Keep time-based waits only when the time threshold is itself under test. Use sane per-class timeouts and capture traces on failure.
181	
182	### P2-14 — Narrow UI tests are sometimes presented as broader integration proof
183	
184	**Evidence:** `e2e/agent-team.mocked.spec.ts` checks an import-history link to `/ai/agents?import=...`, not whether an agent runs. `e2e/core-journey.smoke.spec.ts` asserts `/api/health` booleans/env shape and a navigation, not actual DB/AI service health. Its OpenAI network listener observes browser requests, not necessarily server-side provider calls.
185	
186	**Change:** Accurately rename or move link checks into component tests; keep a clear browser smoke verifying real route access. Rename `health configuration` vs `health dependency readiness`; don't label either as real provider validation.
187	
188	### P2-15 — Performance measurements can mutate QA settings and are not gates
189	
190	**Evidence:** `scripts/perf-interactions.mjs` executes `update public.workspace_settings set ai_models = ai_models - 'chat'` for the QA workspace and does not restore that value in the script. `perf-pages.mjs` and `bench-cards.mts` report medians/p95 but do not enforce budgets. PR #124 found regressions ordinary unit tests missed.
191	
192	**Change:** Use disposable QA snapshot; restore state in `finally`; isolate benchmark process from normal test DB. Establish a few reliable budgets: hidden-tab request count, artifact script bundle, Home CLS and number of duplicate network requests. Compare to committed reference baselines **with tolerances** instead of brittle fixed milliseconds from one machine.
193	
194	### P2-16 — Documentation and AI-agent instructions have drift
195	
196	**Evidence:** `e2e/README.md` says `.mocked` specs need no saved session, while `e2e/service-keys.mocked.spec.ts` requires QA auth; `e2e/import-journey.mocked.spec.ts` refers to `prompt.md §46` which is absent from tracked `main`; `AGENTS.md` says E2E never touches owner workspace without establishing fail-closed verification. `.claude/settings.json` still attaches numerous `entire` lifecycle hooks and `.entire/settings.json` enables Entire telemetry/checkpoints; this is distinct from the **test** acceptance gate. `docs/artifacts-video-script.md` says real balances may be displayed in a recording.
197	
198	**Change:** Update docs only to current behavior and test matrix; remove dead `prompt.md` citations; require synthetic demo data for public recordings by default. Audit whether Entire hooks actually provide useful checkpoints—if not, simplify/disable hooks **separately** from the acceptance test rewrite, preserving user-preferred session capture. Keep Next.js generated agent rules if Next itself rewrites them; avoid endless diff churn.
199	
200	### P2-17 — Missing explicit CI and test categorization
201	
202	**Evidence:** no `.github/workflows` files, only local scripts. `playwright.config.ts` has a single Chromium desktop project. Tests exist for mobile behavior but the default project is not a distinct mobile browser profile.
203	
204	**Change:** Minimal GitHub workflow: privacy/content scan, lint, `tsc --noEmit`, Vitest unit, build on PR. Separately, local/self-hosted QA DB E2E on trusted runner or manual pre-release with no external secrets. Add a *small* targeted mobile-viewport smoke suite, not duplicate every E2E scenario.
205	
206	---
207	
208	## 4. Exact remove / rewrite / keep ledger
209	
210	**Rule:** “REMOVE AFTER REPLACEMENT” means write the named new test first, demonstrate it detects the original failure, and only then delete the old test or test block. A smaller number of green tests is NOT the success metric; failure detection is.
211	
212	| Current item | Verdict | Reason | Replacement / retention requirement |
213	|---|---|---|---|
214	| `scripts/acceptance.test.ts` **two source-text tests** (`enables every live DB gate...`, `serializes required unit files...`) | **REMOVE AFTER REPLACEMENT** | Source grep is brittle and can lie | Behavioral suite selection and invocation tests; keep other production-build/report assertions |
215	| `e2e/agent-team.mocked.spec.ts` (single import-history link test) | **REMOVE AFTER REPLACEMENT** or rename | Playwright is heavy for one link; not agent runtime coverage | Lightweight component/API contract test for link plus real agent-run lifecycle test elsewhere |
216	| `e2e/core-journey.smoke.spec.ts` **“health endpoint reports backend configuration”** | **CONSOLIDATE AFTER REPLACEMENT** | Repeats health handler implementation/env; weak readiness proof | Fast API health-schema test + an isolated actual-backend readiness smoke; retain navigational smoke |

221	| `e2e/auth-refresh.gated.spec.ts` shared `storageState({path: statePath})` | **REWRITE BLOCK; KEEP REFRESH TEST** | Mutates session other tests consume | Unique temp storage state, isolated user; no shared file mutation |
222	| `e2e/import-journey.mocked.spec.ts` delayed 20-second response | **REWRITE BLOCK; KEEP WORKFLOW** | Slow, failure depends on wall-clock | Deferred/pauseable response and deterministic timeout handling |
223	| `supabase/tests/conflict-errcode.test.ts` | **KEEP AS CHEAP LINT GUARD; ADD REAL TEST** | Useful fast feedback but inadequate against #131 | Deployed HTTP 409/no retry regression |
224	| `e2e/artifact-page-protection.mocked.spec.ts` | **KEEP; ADD REAL ROUTE SECURITY TEST** | Important hostile-browser coverage | Actual artifact-frame route/CSP/authorization test |
225	| `lib/finance/net-worth-source.test.ts` | **KEEP; ADD INTEGRATION PROPERTY TEST** | Protects valuable cross-reader invariant | Seeded DB + UI parity and mutation testing |
226	| `e2e/theme-contrast.gated.spec.ts` | **KEEP** | Measures actual browser color contrast, not a superficial snapshot | Improve isolation if expensive |
227	| `e2e/bad-links.gated.spec.ts` | **KEEP** | Tests recovery and unsent draft preservation, real user value | Only refactor if brittle |
228	| `supabase/tests/workspace-isolation.sql` and migration replay suite | **KEEP** | Guard finance privacy/RLS and upgrade safety | Add new tables/paths to matrix |
229	| 8 `.live.test.ts` files | **KEEP; CLASSIFY DB TIER** | Strong SQL/application integration, expensive | Database tier with controlled setup and explicit reporting |
230	| `scripts/bench-cards.mts`, `scripts/perf-pages.mjs` | **KEEP AS BENCHMARKS** | Measurement not “tests”; no gating threshold | Baseline comparison separate from unit suite |
231	| `scripts/perf-interactions.mjs` | **FIX BEFORE NEXT RUN** | Mutates QA model setting without restore | Disposable environment, `try/finally`, verify state restoration |
232	| `.claude/settings.json` Entire hooks | **REVIEW, NOT AUTOMATICALLY DELETE** | Numerous CLI hooks may add friction; user values session history | Measure workflow cost/usefulness; eliminate redundant hooks only with approval |
233	
234	**There is no demonstrated basis to remove all 295 Vitest files or all SQL fixtures.** Large files such as `app/api/chat/route.test.ts` and `lib/import/csv.test.ts` should be *split by behavior* if they slow focused iteration, not deleted for having a high line count.
235	
236	---
237	
238	## 5. New tests to add — prioritized specifications

243	- Given missing/expired/foreign session or non-QA server, runner aborts before mutations.
244	- Given synthetic QA owner + dedicated server, runner proceeds.

260	- Synthetic accounts with overdraft, stale/confirmed balances, investment valuation, internal transfer, pending/posted settlement, duplicate import, one missing balance, multi-currency without invented FX.

301	## 6. Proposed testing architecture (minimal, not a new platform)
302	
303	```text
304	Change lands in a branch
305	        |
306	        v
307	    FAST, every PR           [no DB / no paid providers]
308	    privacy-content + lint + typecheck + Vitest + build
309	        |
310	        +--> finance/schema/import change? --> DB CONTRACT
311	        |                                    disposable self-host QA DB
312	        |                                    SQL/RLS/concurrency + small real API tests
313	        |
314	        +--> UI / chat / artifact change? --> BROWSER REQUIRED
315	        |                                    dedicated QA server + deterministic mocks
316	        |                                    never owner's workspace
317	        |
318	        +--> release / scheduled ----------> FULL E2E + workflow restart + perf
319	        |
320	        +--> explicit human opt-in --------> REAL AI / BANK / SCALABLE SMOKES
321	```
322	
323	**Proposed commands** (names are recommendations, not commands that exist today):
324	
325	- `npm run qa:fast`: privacy + content scanner, lint, `tsc --noEmit`, unit tests, build (or split `qa:code` and `qa:build` to save local time).
326	- `npm run qa:db`: migrations replay + live DB tests + selected SQL concurrency, only disposable QA backend.
327	- `npm run qa:browser`: required offline synthetic Playwright journeys; manifest explicitly excludes opt-in provider specs.
328	- `npm run qa:release`: asserts `qa:fast`, `qa:db`, `qa:browser` and records provenance in ignored `.qa` reports; may require clean worktree, but **not during active editing**.
329	- `npm run qa:provider`: manual real-provider evaluations, disabled by default.
330	- `npm run qa:perf`: repeatable nonblocking baseline comparison with optional warning/threshold mode.
331	
332	**Safety requirements:**
333	1. Never open or reset the owner's workspace in a test. Test DB should be separate Docker Compose project/volumes and test-only `.env`.

337	5. A skipped test is recorded as **not executed**. It becomes a gate failure only when the test is explicitly required and its prerequisites were promised.

396	---

398	## 9. Codex-ready handoff prompt (copy this with the file)
399	
400	```text
401	Read MONEO_DEEP_WEED_AUDIT_2026-11-09.md fully, then inspect the repository at the current main HEAD. The audit is a static hypothesis/evidence list, not proof of runtime failure; revalidate against current code and PR changes. Follow AGENTS.md safety rules.
402	
403	Implement PR-A (QA fail-closed and no-owner tests) first. Then implement PR-B (acceptance selection). Do not implement PR-C/D/E yet unless I explicitly request them.
404	
405	Requirements:
406	- Never connect tests to my personal Moneo workspace or personal Docker volumes. Never use docker compose down -v on owner data. Do not edit .env secrets or applied migrations.
407	- First show exact current behavior, failing regression reproduction (where feasible), the minimal patch, and tests proving the fix.
408	- No paid/live AI, bank or Scalable calls during validation.
409	- Prefer fewer high-signal tests over many mock-only tests. Never remove a useful test without replacement coverage.
410	- Keep a concise change log with paths, tests executed, skipped tests, and unresolved risks.
411	- If any recommended edit conflicts with current architecture, explain and propose the safer equivalent.
412	- Do not commit, push or open a PR unless I ask.
413	```
414	
415	---
416	
417	## 10. Before declaring the weed cleanup successful
418	
419	**Quality gate checklist:**
420	
421	- [ ] No test can accidentally use the owner workspace or a non-QA server.
422	- [ ] Required browser suite contains no opt-in provider tests and has zero state-driven `test.skip` branches.
423	- [ ] A source-code formatting change no longer breaks acceptance-runner tests.
424	- [ ] Old tests removed only after new replacements catch the same failure.
425	- [ ] Cross-screen money totals, SQL conflict errors, artifact exfiltration and import idempotency have direct regressions.
426	- [ ] Actual artifact frame response is tested, not only the HTML/CSP builder helper.
427	- [ ] Full suite order/randomization and QA reset do not affect results.
428	- [ ] CI runs fast meaningful checks automatically without personal secrets.
429	- [ ] Expensive DB/AI/browser/performance tests live in clear separate tiers.
430	- [ ] Docs/AGENTS accurately describe what tests can and cannot prove.
431	- [ ] Required acceptance produces a machine-readable report for the same tested commit and states whether it ran on a disposable QA environment.
432	
433	## 11. Limits and confidence
434	
435	- **High confidence, based on current source:** optional spec inclusion vs zero-skip acceptance; source-text acceptance tests; conditional QA cookie in mocked specs; owner auto-sign-in; reuse of existing dev server; shared auth file write; QA reset replication role; shallow privacy filename check; perf script mutating QA settings; no GitHub Actions; mixed provider/browser journey; PR evidence quoted above.
436	- **Medium confidence, requires runtime reproduction:** actual owner data exposure during a browser test, real suite flakiness under current self-host environment, semantic errors in generated artifact cards, specific live-protocol failures, performance regressions on current HEAD.
437	- **Not established:** that all 355 test files are bad, that the actual owner workspace was altered, that a vulnerability is exploitable outside the intended local deployment, or that the proposed suite will run faster until measured.
438	
439	**Final principle:** A test is a useful fence only when it protects an important behavior, fails when that behavior breaks, and does not force engineers or AI agents to work around an obsolete implementation. **Keep the fence, pull the weed.**

# Moneo: Deep Weed Audit — Tests, PR History, Documentation, Tooling

**Audit date:** 2026-11-09  
**Repository:** https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo  
**Audited branch/HEAD:** `main` at `ce7995b817ec45c719527d7d3dcfcbe7400f214e`  
**Status:** Findings and implementation specification; **no changes made** to the repository.  
**Audience:** Codex / Claude Code / maintainers.  
**Objective:** Reduce maintenance friction and false confidence while increasing protection against genuinely expensive financial, privacy, data-loss, and authorization failures.

> **Read this first:** This is a repository/PR **static audit**, not a claim that the suite was executed on the user's computer. I read GitHub PR metadata for **131 PRs (128 merged; 3 closed unmerged)**, examined important PR bodies and file changes, inventoried the current tree, and inspected representative high-risk tests, runner configuration, instructions and production code. I did **not** execute Docker, Vitest, Playwright, live provider tests, or measure performance. Recommendations labeled *suspected* require a local red/green reproduction before editing behavior. Do not delete tests merely because they are old, large, or mocked.

---

## 0. Executive decision

**Do not delete the entire test suite.** The principal weeds are **selection/orchestration, QA isolation, shared mutable state, implementation-coupled tests, misleading test names, and missing failure-oriented tests**. The best approach is to replace a small number of weak checks, remove their old forms *after* replacement coverage passes, and organize the remaining tests by purpose.

**Five first moves, in order:**

1. **Make test execution safe:** require explicit dedicated QA identity, isolate any browser tests with mutations, refuse to run a browser suite against the owner's workspace or an unverified existing server.
2. **Repair acceptance selection:** optional real-AI/MCP tests must not cause a mandatory zero-skip suite to fail; remove dynamic test skips caused by mutable initial UI state.
3. **Replace implementation-text testing:** retire source-string assertions in `scripts/acceptance.test.ts` once behavioral runner tests exist.
4. **Tie regression coverage to actual severe PR incidents:** deployed `PT409` conflict behavior, cross-screen net-worth parity, artifact exfiltration boundaries, OAuth host-ID contract, import undo/re-import idempotency, and self-host recovery.
5. **Split fast vs DB vs browser vs release vs provider vs performance:** preserve strong SQL/finance/RLS/security tests; avoid one oversized gate for all changes.

**Avoid:** building a second giant testing framework; deleting all unit tests; deleting SQL regression fixtures; reintroducing real AI calls in default CI; changing production data to satisfy test fixtures; editing previously applied migrations; running `docker compose down -v`.

## 3. Findings — confirmed code facts, risk and fix

### P0-01 — Mandatory acceptance includes intentionally optional tests

**Evidence:** `scripts/acceptance.mjs` collects every root `e2e/*.spec.ts` except `core-journey.gated.spec.ts`, then `assertRequiredResults('playwright')` rejects **any** skipped test. Yet `e2e/net-worth-chat.gated.spec.ts` skips without `E2E_REAL_AI`; `e2e/scalable-trading.gated.spec.ts` skips without a local `SCALABLE_MCP_ORIGIN`; `e2e/home-dashboard.gated.spec.ts` skips at runtime if Goals is already first. The runner clears `OPENAI_API_KEY` and does not set the two opt-in variables.

**Impact:** a working application can fail required acceptance for a test it never intended to execute. Also risks live-provider calls when accidental credentials leak into the environment.

**Change:** Explicit allowlists for `qa:smoke`, `qa:db`, `qa:browser-required`, `qa:provider`, `qa:performance`; reject **unexpected** skips only within the relevant required list. Never select opt-in tests for regular browser acceptance. Test that the manifest includes *every* intended required test and excludes every opt-in test. Do not silently exclude new specs: new specs must be classified intentionally.

**Proof:** run `playwright --list` for each manifest; required suite in correct test environment executes with zero skips; optional tests appear only on explicit invocation; no real-provider request during default tests.

### P0-02 — Browser QA identity is not fail-closed

**Evidence:** `e2e/agent-team.mocked.spec.ts`, `e2e/import-journey.mocked.spec.ts`, `e2e/import-control.mocked.spec.ts` use the QA cookie **if** present and otherwise proceed. Self-hosted `proxy.ts` automatically signs in the owner. `e2e/service-keys.mocked.spec.ts` *does* explicitly skip without QA session, showing contradictory policy. `e2e/README.md` says mocked specs need no session and tests never touch the owner workspace.

**Impact:** **risk**, not proven incident: browser tests lacking QA cookies may execute as the automatically signed-in owner. Mocking an API route does not necessarily isolate every server-side read and action.

**Change:** Central `e2e/qa-fixture.ts` with **mandatory** verified QA cookie/owner ID, dedicated synthetic workspace and guarded base URL. No test should run without explicit QA marker. For credential-free tests, serve an **isolated synthetic test server**, never the personal Moneo app. Block writes and fail if the workspace is not marked QA. Add negative tests confirming absent/wrong session refuses before opening browser.

**Proof:** tests cannot start with no QA cookie, expired cookie, different owner or wrong base URL; only synthetic workspace rows change; cleanup checks after each suite.

### P0-03 — E2E test runner may reuse an unintended development server

**Evidence:** `playwright.config.ts`: `reuseExistingServer: !production && !process.env.CI` on port 3000; `E2E_BASE_URL` can point elsewhere. Combined with owner auto-sign-in, this is a potentially unsafe default.

**Change:** Dedicated QA port and explicit readiness/identity response (not just port-open). Disallow shared-dev-server reuse for DB-mutating E2E unless verified as QA. Require `MONEO_TEST_INSTANCE=1` / QA owner marker checked server-side. Make production-build tests start their own known server.

**Proof:** a non-QA server running on the port makes tests abort **before requests**.

### P0-04 — QA reset bypasses database triggers/foreign keys

**Evidence:** `scripts/e2e-auth.mjs --reset` checks `qa_test='e2e-auth'`, then uses `SET LOCAL session_replication_role = replica` and dynamically deletes by `workspace_id`, `actor_id`, `user_id`, `created_by` across all public tables.

**Impact:** Deliberately disabling triggers/FKs can hide real integrity violations, and generic per-column sweeping is difficult to reason about after schema changes. Not evidence that the owner has been harmed; the QA-user guard is good.

**Change:** Prefer disposable DB/isolated Docker or authenticated `reset_workspace()` with exact workspace/owner verification, full cleanup receipts and FK checks enabled. Keep explicit rejection for non-QA users. Fail on unexpected tables, never silently broaden deletion.

**Proof:** seed one QA user and an unrelated user; reset QA; other user data bit-for-bit unchanged; FK/invariant checks remain active; repeatable cleanup even after failed test.

### P1-05 — Acceptance tests assert runner source text

**Evidence:** `scripts/acceptance.test.ts` scans test source and asserts that `scripts/acceptance.mjs` contains exact strings like `RUN_*_DB_TESTS: "1"` and `run("units", ... "--no-file-parallelism")`.

**Impact:** A safe formatting/refactor can fail; a script containing the expected text in an unused branch could pass. Source checks are not proof of execution.

**Change:** Export a pure suite manifest from the runner and test it as data; run a fake runner with success/fail/skip/flaky fixtures in isolated temp dirs, assert exit code, selected files, reports, absence of unexpected skips and provenance behavior. Keep the direct `assertProductionBuild` / `assertRequiredResults` unit cases (valuable).

**Proof:** harmless refactor doesn't fail; removing DB flag from effective runtime config *does* fail.

### P1-06 — Shared mutable E2E session and state

**Evidence:** `e2e/auth-refresh.gated.spec.ts` writes refreshed cookies into the shared `e2e/.auth.json`; browser suites use a persistent QA workspace and require manual `scripts/e2e-auth.mjs --reset`; `e2e/home-dashboard.gated.spec.ts` dynamically skips if Goals already first. PR #140 recorded run-to-run variable failures.

**Change:** Every stateful test should construct its starting data, use unique entities/workspace (or snapshot/reset per group), and not rewrite shared storage state. Convert Goals-first skip to deterministic arrangement or test both move/no-move paths. Collect per-test duration and retry/flake metadata.

**Proof:** randomize suite order; run twice; run parallelizable mocked tests in parallel; no ordering dependency or skip.

### P1-07 — Monolithic and mixed-fidelity browser journey

**Evidence:** `e2e/core-journey.gated.spec.ts` mixes real database import, a real AI chat request, mocked inspect mapping and mocked deep-analysis completion, with 240-second test timeout. It is entirely excluded from required acceptance, although its non-AI part provides valuable product coverage. `e2e/scalable-trading.gated.spec.ts` combines a local MCP stand-in with a real model call.

**Change:** Extract **deterministic app workflows** (import → ledger → re-import, card approval → recorded mutation, chat-tool invocation with stub model), and keep separate **opt-in provider evaluations**. Mark every mock boundary explicitly in test names/report. Never claim a model integration was verified because an API response was mocked.

**Proof:** deterministic journeys pass offline on synthetic QA data; provider checks are separately reported with identity, model and cost labels.

### P1-08 — Behavioral regression absent for catastrophic SQL retry semantics

**Evidence:** `supabase/tests/conflict-errcode.test.ts` is a small regex scanning only migration files lexically later than `202610310001` for one exact `errcode = '40001'` pattern. #131 was a runtime PostgREST retry failure.

**Change:** **Keep** this cheap guard, but add a deployed-PostgREST contract test causing a stale version conflict: assert one timely 409, returned error shape, bounded query count, no sustained retries, and a concurrent independent request still succeeds. Also test equivalent variations of SQLSTATE-raising syntax and all public conflict functions.

**Proof:** the old dangerous behavior fails the new test; correct `PT409` passes. No real owner data.

### P1-09 — Mocked security checks aren't a complete HTTP-boundary guarantee

**Evidence:** `e2e/artifact-page-protection.mocked.spec.ts` is a useful browser test with hostile HTML, attempted `fetch`, beacon, image, popup, iframe/form and navigation. `lib/ai/artifact-data.test.ts` tests CSP strings. However the mocked harness doesn't guarantee the deployed `/ai/artifacts/[id]/frame` route sends exactly the intended CSP/cache headers, auth checks and data-scope checks.

**Change:** Keep both tests. Add a separate **real route HTTP response** test with QA session: inspect actual `Content-Security-Policy`, `Cache-Control: private, no-store`, sandbox/no-same-origin, unauthorized/foreign artifact denial, and re-run hostile payload in actual `ArtifactFrame` with network requests captured.

**Proof:** malicious page cannot send data, navigate to a foreign origin, load remote scripts or access parent cookies; legitimate local charts still render.

### P1-10 — Financial semantic correctness lacks a single cross-system fixture

**Evidence:** #132 repaired mismatched totals; `lib/finance/net-worth-source.test.ts` now tests cross-reader parity with a mocked query interface. Very good, but a real DB/RLS/route/browser multi-surface test is a different boundary. Cards also validate rendering/syntax rather than arbitrary AI-written finance arithmetic.

**Change:** Reuse **one deterministic financial oracle**/fixture for accounts, balances, transfers, pending holds, FX, investments, debt and stale values. Verify API + Home + Accounts + Wealth + chat tool + artifact data outputs. Use property/metamorphic tests: adding balanced internal transfers doesn't change total net worth; same-currency rounding exact; re-import same source doesn't duplicate. For AI-generated cards, define which finance sums **must** come from precomputed trusted data, not model-authored arithmetic.

**Proof:** intentional double-counting/missing-account mutants are killed. Avoid asserting implementation internals or formatting that is not contractual.

### P1-11 — Security/privacy gate's name overstates coverage

**Evidence:** `scripts/check-private-data.mjs` reads `git ls-files -z`, rejects extensions and ignored private directories, but **does not read file contents**. `AGENTS.md` says no secrets/private statements in repo; `pretest`/`prelint` running this script can convey false assurance. #19 removed tracked private bank files.

**Change:** Keep filename guard (valuable). Add secret scanning/content signatures for credential patterns and accidental embedded financial identifiers; support explicit documented allowlist for synthetic fixtures. Run on staged content and all commits/PR diff where feasible, with redacted output. Don't upload private data to a third-party scanner without explicit approval.

**Proof:** synthetic fake token/IBAN embedded in `.ts` or `.md` is flagged, harmless fixture passes, scanner never prints the secret.

### P1-12 — First-install / update / recovery regression untested

**Evidence:** #146 moved deployment to local Docker, data volumes and `.env` secrets; `scripts/setup.mjs` applies migrations and keeps existing secrets; test inventory has migration replay and UI tests but no complete disposable install → update → restore test.

**Change:** In a disposable Docker project and throwaway temp directory, assert fresh install, restart, idempotent setup, migration upgrade, backup/restore and preservation of encrypted tokens/financial rows (using test-only keys). Never run destructive setup/restore against personal volumes. Add backup implementation as a separate project task if not present.

**Proof:** restore exact synthetic ledger + secrets, reinstall doesn't overwrite keys, wrong key fails clearly, volume reset is never used on owner data.

### P2-13 — Fixed sleeps and overly broad timeout budgets

**Evidence:** `e2e/artifact-page-protection.mocked.spec.ts` waits 1,500 ms (for a known delayed attack); `e2e/import-journey.mocked.spec.ts` simulates a 20-second response delay; multiple gated specs allow 180–600 seconds. Timing itself isn't a failure but often makes feedback slow and nonrepeatable.

**Change:** Use deferred promises, clock control or `expect.poll` at the *specific* observable event. Keep time-based waits only when the time threshold is itself under test. Use sane per-class timeouts and capture traces on failure.

### P2-14 — Narrow UI tests are sometimes presented as broader integration proof

**Evidence:** `e2e/agent-team.mocked.spec.ts` checks an import-history link to `/ai/agents?import=...`, not whether an agent runs. `e2e/core-journey.smoke.spec.ts` asserts `/api/health` booleans/env shape and a navigation, not actual DB/AI service health. Its OpenAI network listener observes browser requests, not necessarily server-side provider calls.

**Change:** Accurately rename or move link checks into component tests; keep a clear browser smoke verifying real route access. Rename `health configuration` vs `health dependency readiness`; don't label either as real provider validation.

### P2-15 — Performance measurements can mutate QA settings and are not gates

**Evidence:** `scripts/perf-interactions.mjs` executes `update public.workspace_settings set ai_models = ai_models - 'chat'` for the QA workspace and does not restore that value in the script. `perf-pages.mjs` and `bench-cards.mts` report medians/p95 but do not enforce budgets. PR #124 found regressions ordinary unit tests missed.

**Change:** Use disposable QA snapshot; restore state in `finally`; isolate benchmark process from normal test DB. Establish a few reliable budgets: hidden-tab request count, artifact script bundle, Home CLS and number of duplicate network requests. Compare to committed reference baselines **with tolerances** instead of brittle fixed milliseconds from one machine.

### P2-16 — Documentation and AI-agent instructions have drift

**Evidence:** `e2e/README.md` says `.mocked` specs need no saved session, while `e2e/service-keys.mocked.spec.ts` requires QA auth; `e2e/import-journey.mocked.spec.ts` refers to `prompt.md §46` which is absent from tracked `main`; `AGENTS.md` says E2E never touches owner workspace without establishing fail-closed verification. `.claude/settings.json` still attaches numerous `entire` lifecycle hooks and `.entire/settings.json` enables Entire telemetry/checkpoints; this is distinct from the **test** acceptance gate. `docs/artifacts-video-script.md` says real balances may be displayed in a recording.

**Change:** Update docs only to current behavior and test matrix; remove dead `prompt.md` citations; require synthetic demo data for public recordings by default. Audit whether Entire hooks actually provide useful checkpoints—if not, simplify/disable hooks **separately** from the acceptance test rewrite, preserving user-preferred session capture. Keep Next.js generated agent rules if Next itself rewrites them; avoid endless diff churn.

### P2-17 — Missing explicit CI and test categorization

**Evidence:** no `.github/workflows` files, only local scripts. `playwright.config.ts` has a single Chromium desktop project. Tests exist for mobile behavior but the default project is not a distinct mobile browser profile.

**Change:** Minimal GitHub workflow: privacy/content scan, lint, `tsc --noEmit`, Vitest unit, build on PR. Separately, local/self-hosted QA DB E2E on trusted runner or manual pre-release with no external secrets. Add a *small* targeted mobile-viewport smoke suite, not duplicate every E2E scenario.

## 4. Exact remove / rewrite / keep ledger

**Rule:** “REMOVE AFTER REPLACEMENT” means write the named new test first, demonstrate it detects the original failure, and only then delete the old test or test block. A smaller number of green tests is NOT the success metric; failure detection is.

| Current item | Verdict | Reason | Replacement / retention requirement |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scripts/acceptance.test.ts` **two source-text tests** (`enables every live DB gate...`, `serializes required unit files...`) | **REMOVE AFTER REPLACEMENT** | Source grep is brittle and can lie | Behavioral suite selection and invocation tests; keep other production-build/report assertions |
| `e2e/agent-team.mocked.spec.ts` (single import-history link test) | **REMOVE AFTER REPLACEMENT** or rename | Playwright is heavy for one link; not agent runtime coverage | Lightweight component/API contract test for link plus real agent-run lifecycle test elsewhere |
| `e2e/core-journey.smoke.spec.ts` **“health endpoint reports backend configuration”** | **CONSOLIDATE AFTER REPLACEMENT** | Repeats health handler implementation/env; weak readiness proof | Fast API health-schema test + an isolated actual-backend readiness smoke; retain navigational smoke |
| `e2e/core-journey.gated.spec.ts` | **SPLIT THEN RETIRE MONOLITH** | Real model + mocked inspect/analysis + long mixed journey; currently excluded from required | 2–3 deterministic browser journeys + optional real-provider evaluation |
| `e2e/net-worth-chat.gated.spec.ts` | **MOVE TO OPTIONAL PROVIDER, NOT DELETE PROTECTION** | Real model unsuitable for mandatory deterministic acceptance | Deterministic chat tool / net-worth parity test runs in required; human/model quality check optional |
| `e2e/scalable-trading.gated.spec.ts` | **SPLIT** | Local MCP mock + real model; intentional skip otherwise | Deterministic authorization/preview/submit-once tests mandatory; provider natural-language test optional |
| `e2e/home-dashboard.gated.spec.ts` runtime `test.skip(at === 0)` | **REWRITE BLOCK; DON'T DELETE ENTIRE SPEC** | Starting order masks feature coverage and breaks zero-skip gate | Arrange exact starting order or test both states; no `test.skip` branch |
| `e2e/auth-refresh.gated.spec.ts` shared `storageState({path: statePath})` | **REWRITE BLOCK; KEEP REFRESH TEST** | Mutates session other tests consume | Unique temp storage state, isolated user; no shared file mutation |
| `e2e/import-journey.mocked.spec.ts` delayed 20-second response | **REWRITE BLOCK; KEEP WORKFLOW** | Slow, failure depends on wall-clock | Deferred/pauseable response and deterministic timeout handling |
| `supabase/tests/conflict-errcode.test.ts` | **KEEP AS CHEAP LINT GUARD; ADD REAL TEST** | Useful fast feedback but inadequate against #131 | Deployed HTTP 409/no retry regression |
| `e2e/artifact-page-protection.mocked.spec.ts` | **KEEP; ADD REAL ROUTE SECURITY TEST** | Important hostile-browser coverage | Actual artifact-frame route/CSP/authorization test |
| `lib/finance/net-worth-source.test.ts` | **KEEP; ADD INTEGRATION PROPERTY TEST** | Protects valuable cross-reader invariant | Seeded DB + UI parity and mutation testing |
| `e2e/theme-contrast.gated.spec.ts` | **KEEP** | Measures actual browser color contrast, not a superficial snapshot | Improve isolation if expensive |
| `e2e/bad-links.gated.spec.ts` | **KEEP** | Tests recovery and unsent draft preservation, real user value | Only refactor if brittle |
| `supabase/tests/workspace-isolation.sql` and migration replay suite | **KEEP** | Guard finance privacy/RLS and upgrade safety | Add new tables/paths to matrix |
| 8 `.live.test.ts` files | **KEEP; CLASSIFY DB TIER** | Strong SQL/application integration, expensive | Database tier with controlled setup and explicit reporting |
| `scripts/bench-cards.mts`, `scripts/perf-pages.mjs` | **KEEP AS BENCHMARKS** | Measurement not “tests”; no gating threshold | Baseline comparison separate from unit suite |
| `scripts/perf-interactions.mjs` | **FIX BEFORE NEXT RUN** | Mutates QA model setting without restore | Disposable environment, `try/finally`, verify state restoration |
| `.claude/settings.json` Entire hooks | **REVIEW, NOT AUTOMATICALLY DELETE** | Numerous CLI hooks may add friction; user values session history | Measure workflow cost/usefulness; eliminate redundant hooks only with approval |

**There is no demonstrated basis to remove all 295 Vitest files or all SQL fixtures.** Large files such as `app/api/chat/route.test.ts` and `lib/import/csv.test.ts` should be *split by behavior* if they slow focused iteration, not deleted for having a high line count.

## 5. New tests to add — prioritized specifications

### MUST ADD (P0/P1)

**T01 `e2e/qa-identity.spec.ts` or `scripts/verify-qa-environment.test.ts`: safe test environment**
- Given missing/expired/foreign session or non-QA server, runner aborts before mutations.
- Given synthetic QA owner + dedicated server, runner proceeds.
- Seed unrelated user; after test, unrelated user rows and secrets unchanged.
- Assert no browser tests touch owner auto-sign-in as a fallback.

**T02 `scripts/acceptance-runner.test.ts`: behavioral suite selection**
- Fake runner receives exact required file list and flags; optional real-AI/Scalable excluded.
- A failing, flaky, empty, skipped *required* report fails; optional skipped suites do not block required.
- A clean matching build provenance passes; mismatch fails; output reports tested SHA/manifest and reason.
- `test --list` plus test manifest validation catches unclassified new E2E files.

**T03 `supabase/tests/conflict-http.integration.*`: actual PostgREST 409 and no retries**
- Create synthetic workspace and stale version; call production RPC/HTTP path.
- Assert status 409, a bounded number of SQL attempts/elapsed time, independent concurrent `/api/health`/workspace read responsive.
- Inject/verify common `40001` variants in a *disposable schema* if safe.

**T04 `e2e/net-worth-parity.qa.spec.ts`: one ledger, six readers**
- Synthetic accounts with overdraft, stale/confirmed balances, investment valuation, internal transfer, pending/posted settlement, duplicate import, one missing balance, multi-currency without invented FX.
- Compare numerical canonical values for Home, Accounts, Wealth, chart, chat finance tool, artifact query. Assert honest freshness and unknown/coverage status.
- Implement a lower-level property test: balanced internal transfer does not change net worth; re-import same source does not increase holdings.

**T05 `e2e/artifact-frame-boundary.qa.spec.ts`: deployed hostile page**
- Real GET to frame route with owned artifact; assert CSP, cache and auth headers; foreign/unowned ID is denied.
- Hostile generated script attempts `fetch`, `sendBeacon`, image, popup, iframe, external form, top/parent/self navigation and remote CDN. Observe *zero* outbound contacts.
- Local ECharts still works; data-scope revocation prevents later access. No sensitive data logged.

**T06 `scripts/setup-recovery.qa.*`: fresh/upgrade/restore**
- Disposable Docker namespace only. Fresh install, persistence through restart, idempotent second `setup`, forward migrations and restore from backup.
- Data and encryption secrets preserved. Wrong key/unavailable volume return clear errors; no personal volumes touched.

**T07 `scripts/check-private-data-content.test.ts`: leaked content detection**

- Start finance read; revoke scope mid-flight; verify response never contains revoked data.
- Workspace switch / other-user IDs denied. This should supplement, not duplicate, the existing mocked `app/api/chat/route.test.ts` tests.

---

## 6. Proposed testing architecture (minimal, not a new platform)

```text
Change lands in a branch
        |
        v
    FAST, every PR           [no DB / no paid providers]
    privacy-content + lint + typecheck + Vitest + build
        |
        +--> finance/schema/import change? --> DB CONTRACT
        |                                    disposable self-host QA DB
        |                                    SQL/RLS/concurrency + small real API tests
        |
        +--> UI / chat / artifact change? --> BROWSER REQUIRED
        |                                    dedicated QA server + deterministic mocks
        |                                    never owner's workspace
        |
        +--> release / scheduled ----------> FULL E2E + workflow restart + perf
        |
        +--> explicit human opt-in --------> REAL AI / BANK / SCALABLE SMOKES
```

**Proposed commands** (names are recommendations, not commands that exist today):

- `npm run qa:fast`: privacy + content scanner, lint, `tsc --noEmit`, unit tests, build (or split `qa:code` and `qa:build` to save local time).
- `npm run qa:db`: migrations replay + live DB tests + selected SQL concurrency, only disposable QA backend.
- `npm run qa:browser`: required offline synthetic Playwright journeys; manifest explicitly excludes opt-in provider specs.
- `npm run qa:release`: asserts `qa:fast`, `qa:db`, `qa:browser` and records provenance in ignored `.qa` reports; may require clean worktree, but **not during active editing**.
- `npm run qa:provider`: manual real-provider evaluations, disabled by default.
- `npm run qa:perf`: repeatable nonblocking baseline comparison with optional warning/threshold mode.

**Safety requirements:**
1. Never open or reset the owner's workspace in a test. Test DB should be separate Docker Compose project/volumes and test-only `.env`.
2. No paid provider access by default; mock calls and assert no unauthorized outgoing connections.
3. No `session_replication_role=replica` as routine reset; no `docker compose down -v` on user volumes.
4. Delete exact synthetic IDs only, assert cleanup; recovery journals stay ignored.
5. A skipped test is recorded as **not executed**. It becomes a gate failure only when the test is explicitly required and its prerequisites were promised.
6. All E2E assertions should wait for app readiness/state rather than fixed sleeps; do not loosen security or finance correctness assertions to make a flaky test green.
7. Test reports include suite, commit, environment, skipped count, retries, duration, mocked boundaries and provider costs; no user data.

| File | Required correction |
|---|---|
| `AGENTS.md` | Add testing tier guide and absolute fail-closed QA rule. Explain “small focused test while coding, broader suite before PR/release”. Preserve key safety rules. Avoid asking an agent to run full E2E against personal env. |
| `e2e/README.md` | Replace claim that all `.mocked` specs work without session. Document QA-only port, session verification, exact commands and opt-in provider suites. |
| `supabase/tests/README.md` | Document disposable-DB execution, which tests are release-required, concurrency tools and isolation/cost. |
| `README.md` | Add safe backup/restore guidance once implementation exists; note that updating/setting up is not a substitute for a backup. |
| `e2e/import-journey.mocked.spec.ts` comments | Replace missing `prompt.md §46` reference with maintained specification or remove link. |
| `.claude/settings.json`, `.entire/settings.json` | Audit whether CLI is installed and hooks/checkpoints help. Keep or simplify based on measured value; **not part of acceptance gate**. |
| `docs/artifacts-video-script.md` | For public demonstration use synthetic balances/transactions by default; avoid relying on displaying private account data. |

**Do not mass-rewrite documentation.** PR history shows large rewrites quickly diverge. Make docs executable where possible: commands and paths verified by a small smoke/static test, not prose duplicated in five places.

## 8. Suggested Codex implementation PRs — each independently reviewable

### PR-A — QA fail-closed and no-owner tests (P0)
**Files:** `playwright.config.ts`, `e2e/fixtures.ts`, `scripts/e2e-auth.mjs`, selected `.mocked.spec.ts`, new QA identity tests, `e2e/README.md`.

**Changes:** QA-only port and identity, no fallback to owner session, isolate storage state, safe reset. Make any destructive work require disposable QA DB. **Do not run full E2E before safety preflight exists.**

**Acceptance:** missing QA state/server blocks; unrelated user unaffected; smoke and mocked specs run on QA-only server.

### PR-B — Replace bad acceptance gate (P0)
**Files:** `scripts/acceptance.mjs`, `scripts/acceptance-results.mjs`, `scripts/acceptance.test.ts`, new runner test/manifest, `package.json`.

**Changes:** explicit required/optional classification, no runtime dynamic skip in mandatory specs; behavioral runner test; preserve clean-build provenance for release. Keep existing critical assertions.

**Files:** `e2e/core-journey.gated.spec.ts`, `e2e/net-worth-chat.gated.spec.ts`, `e2e/scalable-trading.gated.spec.ts`, `e2e/agent-team.mocked.spec.ts`, `e2e/core-journey.smoke.spec.ts`, `e2e/home-dashboard.gated.spec.ts`, `e2e/auth-refresh.gated.spec.ts`, `e2e/import-journey.mocked.spec.ts`.

**Acceptance:** isolated repeated runs pass, randomized order, no skips in required suite; credible path to detect the same failures covered before.

### PR-D — Incident-driven financial/security regressions (P1)
**Files:** new deployed conflict test, net-worth parity fixture, artifact-frame actual route test, import idempotency, QA user isolation.

**Changes:** direct tests of incidents #131/#132/#160/#174 + source/undo invariants. Keep existing SQL and sandbox tests.

**Acceptance:** each new test has a named failure mode; mutation or controlled regression makes it fail.

### PR-E — Operational + performance coverage (P1/P2)
**Files:** disposable setup/upgrade/restore scripts, `scripts/perf-interactions.mjs`, benchmark harness, minimal `.github/workflows`, docs.

**Changes:** safe backup/restore testing, restore settings after perf, nonflaky budgets, fast CI with no credentials. Keep costly tests scheduled/opt-in.

## 9. Codex-ready handoff prompt (copy this with the file)

```text
Read MONEO_DEEP_WEED_AUDIT_2026-11-09.md fully, then inspect the repository at the current main HEAD. The audit is a static hypothesis/evidence list, not proof of runtime failure; revalidate against current code and PR changes. Follow AGENTS.md safety rules.

Implement PR-A (QA fail-closed and no-owner tests) first. Then implement PR-B (acceptance selection). Do not implement PR-C/D/E yet unless I explicitly request them.

Requirements:
- Never connect tests to my personal Moneo workspace or personal Docker volumes. Never use docker compose down -v on owner data. Do not edit .env secrets or applied migrations.
- First show exact current behavior, failing regression reproduction (where feasible), the minimal patch, and tests proving the fix.
- No paid/live AI, bank or Scalable calls during validation.
- Prefer fewer high-signal tests over many mock-only tests. Never remove a useful test without replacement coverage.
- Keep a concise change log with paths, tests executed, skipped tests, and unresolved risks.
- If any recommended edit conflicts with current architecture, explain and propose the safer equivalent.
- Do not commit, push or open a PR unless I ask.
```

---

## 10. Before declaring the weed cleanup successful

**Quality gate checklist:**

- [ ] No test can accidentally use the owner workspace or a non-QA server.
- [ ] Required browser suite contains no opt-in provider tests and has zero state-driven `test.skip` branches.
- [ ] A source-code formatting change no longer breaks acceptance-runner tests.
- [ ] Old tests removed only after new replacements catch the same failure.
- [ ] Cross-screen money totals, SQL conflict errors, artifact exfiltration and import idempotency have direct regressions.
- [ ] Actual artifact frame response is tested, not only the HTML/CSP builder helper.
- [ ] Full suite order/randomization and QA reset do not affect results.
- [ ] CI runs fast meaningful checks automatically without personal secrets.
- [ ] Expensive DB/AI/browser/performance tests live in clear separate tiers.
- [ ] Docs/AGENTS accurately describe what tests can and cannot prove.
- [ ] Required acceptance produces a machine-readable report for the same tested commit and states whether it ran on a disposable QA environment.

## 11. Limits and confidence

- **High confidence, based on current source:** optional spec inclusion vs zero-skip acceptance; source-text acceptance tests; conditional QA cookie in mocked specs; owner auto-sign-in; reuse of existing dev server; shared auth file write; QA reset replication role; shallow privacy filename check; perf script mutating QA settings; no GitHub Actions; mixed provider/browser journey; PR evidence quoted above.
- **Medium confidence, requires runtime reproduction:** actual owner data exposure during a browser test, real suite flakiness under current self-host environment, semantic errors in generated artifact cards, specific live-protocol failures, performance regressions on current HEAD.
- **Not established:** that all 355 test files are bad, that the actual owner workspace was altered, that a vulnerability is exploitable outside the intended local deployment, or that the proposed suite will run faster until measured.

**Final principle:** A test is a useful fence only when it protects an important behavior, fails when that behavior breaks, and does not force engineers or AI agents to work around an obsolete implementation. **Keep the fence, pull the weed.**

13:- The owner says existing application data is disposable. You may reset/reseed it when needed. 31:2. Create `implementation-progress.md` with a requirement checklist, dependencies, acceptance criteria, assigned file ownership, verified results, commit IDs, decisions, and blockers. Keep it concise and current. Mark items complete only with evidence.
32:3. Break work into bounded vertical slices. Prioritize import/financial correctness before polishing or expanding outputs built on that data. Give each agent a specific outcome, owned paths, dependencies, acceptance cases, and reporting format.
33:4. Delegate independent work up to the available concurrency limit. Suggested roles: financial correctness/imports/database; Money/Plan workflows; AI/artifacts/settings; UI/journey QA. Roles are temporary assignments, not a new application framework.
34:5. Avoid simultaneous edits to shared schema, migrations, navigation, common financial functions, or tests. Assign an owner, sequence dependencies, and coordinate schema/interface changes before consumers implement them. Use isolated worktrees when helpful. Never run multiple builds/dev servers against the same `.next` directory.
35:6. Require agents to report changed files, behavior, tests actually run, residual risks, and any blocker. Independently inspect every diff and validate integration. An agent saying done is not acceptance evidence.
36:7. Have another agent review each substantial slice for correctness, financial semantics, security, plan coverage, and unnecessary complexity. Address findings before accepting it. Do not build an endless review loop: close actionable findings and move on.
37:8. Run the smallest relevant checks during development and commit coherent verified slices. After integration, run the full gates and live journeys. Fix root causes and relevant sibling callers rather than patching symptoms at individual screens.
41:Use existing utilities, installed dependencies, standard APIs, and nearby patterns before introducing new abstractions. Read the relevant installed Next.js guides before writing framework-sensitive code. Use meaningful regression tests for financial/security branches and broken journeys; avoid tests that merely mirror implementation.
49:Corrections, splits, links, deletes, import undo, and planning edits must be audited, versioned/concurrency-safe, and reversible where appropriate. Preserve sources and original records. Propagate corrections to Home, budgets, goals, forecasts, recurring inference, tool snapshots, search, and subsequent AI reviews. Invalidate/review derived assumptions when their evidence changes, while preserving intentional user overrides. Keep old saved reviews historically accurate and visibly dated/stale rather than rewriting them.
51:Support cross-currency transfers and partial/multiple refunds explicitly. Preserve each leg's original amount/currency; transferred principal is not income/spending, and fees are separate. Require dated FX evidence for comparisons rather than inventing a rate. Refunds retain their posting currency and attributable category; never relabel an amount into the original purchase currency without conversion. Test unmatched legs, partial refunds, multiple refunds, currency conversion, and undo.
53:Each new schema change gets a new ordered migration. Keep `lib/db/schema.ts` aligned with tables, columns, relationships, deletion behavior, indexes, and constraints. Check both a fresh migration path and the existing deployed migration path. Preserve RLS and workspace-scoped relationships; service-role workflows must enforce their own scope.
65:Treat recurring patterns as inferred until reviewed. Support confirmation, correction, dismissal, effective dates, and historical evidence. Changes affect future forecasts consistently. Do not categorize every inbound payment as income or every outbound payment as consumption when it is a transfer, savings movement, investment contribution, or debt principal.
77:Financial Model is the central area for the facts, assumptions, and rules used across the app, with provenance, editing controls, enabled/confirmed state, and history. Include relevant balance/valuation/FX sources and planning defaults. Use Europe/Berlin calendar periods and test DST, month boundaries, leap years, and end-of-month recurrence.
81:Deliver persistent conversations, a consistent contextual side panel, thorough saved financial reviews, a tool library, and visible activity history. Support cancellation and honest queued/running/completed/failed/canceled states across chat, reviews, generation, and background work. Preserve useful partial work where safe; cancel must prevent new writes after cancellation becomes effective.
